name: machete
description: A suite of small Mac tools in one menu bar app: Copilot, Dictation, Rewrite, Windows, Clipboard, Screenshots, Snippets and Calculator.

scripts.start: bun run native && bun run build && electron .
scripts.verify: bun run lint && bun run test
scripts.pack: bun run native && bun scripts/build.ts --production && electron-builder --mac --dir -c.mac.identity=- -c.mac.notarize=false -c.mac.entitlements=scripts/entitlements.adhoc.plist -c.mac.entitlementsInherit=scripts/entitlements.adhoc.plist && bun scripts/sign-local.ts
scripts.dist: bun run native && bun scripts/build.ts --production && electron-builder --mac --publish never

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Machete transcribes your microphone so it can answer with conversation context.
extendInfo.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Machete transcribes audio on-device to build a live transcript.
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: Machete reads your screen and system audio to answer questions about what you are looking at.
